profile.name: PCO Sensicam CCD科学相机
profile.description: 这是一款用于实验成像采集的 PCO Sensicam CCD 相机。驱动显示其支持曝光控制、触发模式、感兴趣区域（ROI）、像素合并（binning）、成像模式设置，以及 CCD 图像读出，适合实验室中的科学成像与单次/连续采集任务。
profile.description_en: This is a PCO Sensicam CCD camera for laboratory image acquisition. The driver indicates support for exposure control, trigger mode, region of interest (ROI), pixel binning, imaging mode configuration, and CCD image readout, making it suitable for scientific imaging and single or continuous acquisition tasks in the lab.
